status: Engineering selection; physical connector fit, installed cable routing and RF performance require validation

antenna.connector: SMA plug, standard polarity, center pin
antenna.pattern: Omnidirectional dipole, tilt/swivel; gain is not a coverage guarantee

pigtail.radio_end: AMC right-angle plug; U.FL-compatible family, not MHF III/4
pigtail.enclosure_end: SMA straight bulkhead jack, standard polarity, center socket
pigtail.routing_status: Nominal length must pass the enclosure route check and a physical dry fit; never tension the module connector

paths.label: BLE
paths.path: ESP32-WROVER-IE RF connector -> dedicated pigtail -> BLE bulkhead -> antenna
paths.selection: Factory external RF path; legacy Bluetooth LE 4.2 advertisements/connections; Wi-Fi unused for network transport

paths.label: THREAD
paths.path: TinyC6[D] U.FL -> dedicated pigtail -> THREAD bulkhead -> antenna
paths.selection: MC2-C RCP selects and verifies FXL6408 XIO0 HIGH on local C6 SDA6/SCL7, address 0x43, before radio initialization; reset defaults to onboard antenna

paths.label: ZIGBEE
paths.path: XIAO U.FL -> dedicated pigtail -> ZIGBEE bulkhead -> antenna
paths.selection: External NCP build: PB04=1, PB05=1 before radio initialization; internal and external antennas are not used simultaneously

assembly: Connect one antenna to each independent radio. No passive combiner or shared antenna.
SMA and RP-SMA have different center contacts. Buy the exact standard-SMA antenna and bulkhead variants.
Mate miniature coax plugs axially with power removed and support the board; provide slack and strain relief.
Use the fit coupon before printing the whole shell. Published nominal metal dimensions are not printed-fit measurements.
Use module- and region-appropriate transmit power. This prototype does not establish radio certification for sale.

unchanged_paths.CC1101: Existing matched 433.92MHz antenna, separate from all three 2.4GHz paths
unchanged_paths.ZAC93: Existing regional module with its stock PCB antenna
unchanged_paths.LD2450: Stock 24 GHz printed radar array; no coax/whip conversion
